page.layout: One page of running text; marginal notes in the left margin (three notes beside the first paragraphs, plus one small mark beside the second paragraph).

main_text.p: Iesuitismus cor[?] / Factionis Hispa- / nica in Gallia.quo vulgò dicunt, quod in corporis humani structura fit primum vivens & vltimum moriens. Prædicta fanè factio priùs opprimi non potuit aut eradicari, quàm Iesuitæ regno exigerentur. Quod fidele & perdurans robur Instituto huic in tam variegata hominum colluvie nil aliud præstat, quàm ea quæ hactenus de Politiæ forma diximus.

Num verò hæc talia sint, à quibus sibi Resp. Polona metuere debeat, tibi cogitandum relinquo. Ego interim Factionem Iesuiticam inter nos non aliter æstimo, quàm agilem quendam & acutum gladium, cuius lamina quidem in vaginam Polonicam recondita sit, sed ita, vt Nb.[?]capulum Romana Aula & Hispanus manibus teneant, & sic eum ad nutum suum vibrent. Id quod Instituti huius proprius finis aliquando clarius docebit.

Finis Instituti Iesuitici.Hic autem & ipse quiddam singulare & ab omnibus aliis Monachorum ordinibus diuersum habet. Omnes enim aliorum Religiosorum Ordines in hunc finem vt plurimum inuenti & approbati sunt, & eò tendunt, vt popularis deuotio per eos augeatur, Religio Romano-Catholica magis splendeat, & Ordinis spiritualium pomœria dilatentur, &c.

Iesuitæ verò etsi hisce rebus & ipsi pro virili studeant, sui tamen principalis finis longè sublimiorem scopum sibi præfixum habent. Qui nempe est, Vt Romanæ Ecclesiæ siue Imperii Ecclesiastici collapsam autoritatem, non solùm recu-

page.notes: Marginal note at top left is partly worn; "Iesuitismus" and "cor" are uncertain, marked [?]. The small mark beside "capulum" is read as "Nb." and is uncertain. The catchword "recu-" is partly cut off at the foot and its hyphen is uncertain. The running head is set in small capitals and has been given in ordinary case. Spelling of u/v was normalised as instructed (viuens to vivens, vltimum to ultimum).
